name: ivan-the-forwarder
description: Monorepo task runner. `npm install` sets up everything, `npm run dev` starts backend + frontend.

scripts.postinstall: uv sync --directory backend && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.gen:types: uv run --directory backend python scripts/export_openapi.py && npm --prefix frontend run gen:types
scripts.check: npm run gen:types && npm test && npm run typecheck && git diff --exit-code -- shared frontend/src/api/schema.ts data/seed
